normalization.measured_surface: divide all four measured rows by one global measured-response maximum
normalization.predicted_surface: if evaluated, normalize independently by its own global optimum
normalization.purpose: preserve the published depth dependence while preventing any absolute-scale comparison

no_fit_statement: No timing shift, model fit, per-depth normalization, or absolute sensitivity comparison was performed.

bootstrap.scope: digitization uncertainty only; experimental error bars were not published for Figure 2b

interpretation: The data resolve distinct lower- and higher-frequency resonance regions over intermediate thresholds, followed by their merger as the response floor is relaxed. This is evidence that beta_0 captures spectral structure, not a validation of the project's 200 kHz optimum.
guardrail: This surface tests whether connected resonance structure transfers across four XY8 depths. It does not validate the project's 200 kHz sensitivity optimum or establish that N=20 is optimal for the DeVience device.

source.citation: S. J. DeVience et al., Nanoscale NMR spectroscopy and imaging of multiple nuclear species, Nature Nanotechnology 10, 129-134 (2015).
source.sample: fluorinated PFOS/POSF sample measured with a single shallow NV centre
